title: Cause & Contrast: 由于, 既然, 因此, 之所以…是因为, 尽管, 却, 反而, 而
description: Formal reasons and results, 'since (as you say)', effect-before-cause, although, however, on the contrary, and contrastive 而.

points.title: 由于 …，(因此 / 所以) …: due to
points.summary: 由于 (yóuyú) = because of (more formal than 因为). Pairs with 因此 or 所以, not with 因为.
examples: The flight was cancelled due to the weather.

points.title: 既然 … 就 …: since (now that)
points.summary: 既然 (jìrán) A，就 B = since A is a fact (we both know), then B.
points.body: - **既然**你不舒服，**就**早点儿回家吧.
examples: {既然|jìrán}{你|nǐ}{已经|yǐjīng}{决定|juédìng}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{什么|shénme}{了|le}。
Since you've already decided, I won't say anything more.

points.title: …，因此 …: therefore
points.summary: 因此 (yīncǐ) = therefore — starts the result clause (before the subject or right after it).
points.body: - 他每天坚持锻炼，**因此**身体一直很好.
examples: This road is narrow, so there are often traffic jams.

points.title: 之所以 … 是因为 …: the reason … is that
points.summary: Effect first: A 之所以 B，是因为 C = the reason A does B is C.
points.body: - 我**之所以**学中文，**是因为**我对中国文化感兴趣.
examples: {他|tā}{之所以|zhī suǒyǐ}{迟到|chídào}，{是|shì}{因为|yīnwèi}{路|lù}{上|shang}{堵车|dǔchē}。
The reason he was late is that there was a traffic jam.

points.title: 尽管 … (但是 / 还是 …): although
points.summary: 尽管 (jǐnguǎn) A，(但是 / 可是) 还是 B = although A, (still) B.
points.body: - **尽管**很累，他**还是**坚持完成了工作.
examples: {尽管|jǐnguǎn}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{大雨|dàyǔ}，{比赛|bǐsài}{还是|háishi}{照常|zhàocháng}{进行|jìnxíng}。
Despite the heavy rain, the match went ahead as normal.

points.title: 却: however, yet
points.summary: 却 (què) is an adverb: it goes **after the subject, before the verb** (not at the start like 但是).
examples: {他|tā}{学|xué}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}，{中文|Zhōngwén}{却|què}{说|shuō}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}。
He's studied for years, yet his Chinese isn't very good.

points.title: 反而: on the contrary, instead
points.summary: 反而 (fǎn'ér) = the opposite of what you'd expect happened. Often 不但没…，反而….
points.body: - 吃了药，病不但没好，**反而**更严重了.
examples: I helped him, and instead he got angry with me.

points.title: A，而 B: whereas
points.summary: 而 (ér) contrasts two parallel statements: whereas, while.
points.body: - 南方人喜欢吃米饭，**而**北方人喜欢吃面食.
examples: I like peace and quiet, whereas she likes it lively.

questions.prompt: （　）{天气|tiānqì}{原因|yuányīn}，{今天|jīntiān}{的|de}{航班|hángbān}{取消|qǔxiāo}{了|le}。
questions.translation: Today's flight was cancelled due to the weather.

questions.prompt: {由于|yóuyú}{他|tā}{工作|gōngzuò}{努力|nǔlì}，（　）{很|hěn}{快|kuài}{就|jiù}{升职|shēngzhí}{了|le}。
questions.translation: Because he worked hard, he was soon promoted.

questions.prompt: {既然|jìrán}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{舒服|shūfu}，（　）{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{吧|ba}。
questions.translation: Since you're not feeling well, go home early.

questions.prompt: （　）{你|nǐ}{已经|yǐjīng}{决定|juédìng}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{什么|shénme}{了|le}。
questions.translation: Since you've already decided, I won't say anything more.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{每天|měitiān}{坚持|jiānchí}{锻炼|duànliàn}，（　）{身体|shēntǐ}{一直|yìzhí}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
notes: 既然 introduces a known fact, not a result.
因为 introduces a reason, not a result.
questions.translation: He exercises every day, so he's always been healthy.

notes: 因此 belongs to the result clause.
因此 starts the result clause.
因此 introduces the result, not the cause.
questions.translation: This road is narrow, so there are often traffic jams.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{之所以|zhī suǒyǐ}{学|xué}{中文|Zhōngwén}，（　）{因为|yīnwèi}{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōngguó}{文化|wénhuà}{感兴趣|gǎn xìngqù}。
notes: 所以 is already part of 之所以.
之所以 pairs with 是因为.
之所以 pairs with 是因为.
questions.translation: The reason I'm learning Chinese is that I'm interested in Chinese culture.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{之所以|zhī suǒyǐ}{迟到|chídào}，{是|shì}{因为|yīnwèi}{路|lù}{上|shang}{堵车|dǔchē}。」 mean?
questions.explanation: Effect first: **之所以 effect，是因为 cause**.
notes: That's not what 之所以 means.
The cause is the jam, not his lateness.

questions.prompt: {尽管|jǐnguǎn}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{他|tā}（　）{坚持|jiānchí}{完成|wánchéng}{了|le}{工作|gōngzuò}。
notes: 所以 — tiredness doesn't cause finishing.
因此 — no cause and effect.
questions.translation: Although he was tired, he kept going and finished the job.

questions.prompt: （　）{下|xià}{着|zhe}{大雨|dàyǔ}，{比赛|bǐsài}{还是|háishi}{照常|zhàocháng}{进行|jìnxíng}。
notes: 由于 gives a reason — rain doesn't cause the match to go on.
questions.translation: Despite the heavy rain, the match went ahead as normal.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{学|xué}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}，{中文|Zhōngwén}（　）{说|shuō}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}。
questions.translation: He's studied for years, yet his Chinese isn't very good.

questions.prompt:
Where does **{却|què}** go?
{大家|dàjiā}［A］{都|dōu}［B］{去|qù}{了|le}，{他|tā}［C］{没|méi}［D］{去|qù}。
notes: 却 belongs to the second clause.
却 belongs to the second clause.

questions.prompt: {吃|chī}{了|le}{药|yào}，{病|bìng}{不但|búdàn}{没|méi}{好|hǎo}，（　）{更|gèng}{严重|yánzhòng}{了|le}。
questions.translation: After taking the medicine, he didn't get better — he got worse.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{帮|bāng}{了|le}{他|tā}，{他|tā}{反而|fǎn'ér}{生|shēng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{气|qì}。」 mean?
notes: 反而 = the opposite of what you'd expect.

questions.prompt: {南方人|nánfāng rén}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{吃|chī}{米饭|mǐfàn}，（　）{北方人|běifāng rén}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{吃|chī}{面食|miànshí}。
notes: 且 alone doesn't link clauses like this.
questions.translation: Southerners like rice, whereas northerners like wheat-based food.

options: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{安静|ānjìng}，{因此|yīncǐ}{她|tā}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{热闹|rènao}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{安静|ānjìng}，{而且|érqiě}{她|tā}{也|yě}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{安静|ānjìng}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{安静|ānjìng}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{她|tā}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{热闹|rènao}。
notes: 因此 — no cause and effect.
所以 — her taste isn't caused by mine.
questions.translation: I like peace and quiet, whereas she likes it lively.
